title: House prosecutors to present records of VP Duterte’s business interests

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutors will present corporate and government records to support allegations that Vice President Sara Duterte retained financial interests and continued participating in private businesses after assuming office in 2022, prosecution legal spokesperson and counsel Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr. said Saturday.“ Isa sa mga points raised in the articles of impeachment, ’yung hindi pag-divest sa mga businesses and participating in those businesses kahit na noong panahon na naging vice president na siya,” Tolosa said at the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City. (One of the points raised in the articles of impeachment is the failure to divest from businesses and continuing to participate in those businesses even after she became vice president.)
